Hours of Operation

Hours of Operation at UMass RecWell Facilities

Recreation facilities are for use by students, faculty/staff, associates & alumni with valid UCard with RecWell membership.

Schedule subject to change without notice.

Recreation Center

Monday - Thursday: 6:00am -11:00pm
Friday: 6:00am - 10:00pm
Saturday - Sunday: 10:00am - 10:00pm

RockWell Climbing Gym

Monday - Thursday: 12:00pm - 10:00pm
Friday - Sunday: 12:00pm - 8:00pm

Pools 

Boyden - Beginning Monday, March 30, 2026 

Monday - Friday: 11:00am - 12:30pm
Tuesday & Thursday: 5:30pm -8:00pm

Curry Hicks

Monday: 11:00am - 2:00pm, 5:00pm - 7:00pm
Tuesday & Thursday: 9:00am - 12:00pm
Wednesday: 7:00am - 2:00pm, 5:00pm - 7:00pm
Friday: 7:00am - 9:00am, 10:30am - 6:00pm
Saturday:  11:00am - 7:30pm
Sunday: 11:00am - 5:00pm

**Please Note the Hicks Pool will be CLOSED on the following dates:
Saturday, April 4, 2026
Saturday, April 11, 2026

Boyden Gymnasium

No longer in use by RecWell. Open recreation is held at the Rec Center.
